rationale: The pain is real and specific — developers do encounter breaking changes and deprecations when upgrading dependencies — but evidence remains thin (single forum post, signal_strength 2) and willingness-to-pay is undermined by robust free alternatives (Renovate, Dependabot, npm audit). The build gates fail on both buildability_with_ai (4/10) and operational_autonomy (5/10), and no evidence meets the minimum 5 distinct pain quotes or a clear willingness-to-pay signal beyond a single requester's preference for a paid option.
